title: Run the end-to-end CTAL demonstration
disclosure: Recorded output of the real code run on synthetic data. Not a hosted service; not production behavior.
steps: The demo creates a temporary ledger with development keys and synthetic content.
It gates content under four AQPD/CLES combinations.
It exports a signed evidence package and verifies it offline (exit 0).
It tampers with one envelope and shows the verifier fail (exit 1).
limitations: Development keys and synthetic data only. Recorded output of a real run; not a hosted service.
